findings_detail.reason: The invariant plural verb no informaron disagrees when exactly one runtime did not report; use a number-neutral nominal phrase without changing the simple-argument contract.
findings_detail.evidence: Production tr_record: subagents_unreported='1', runtimes=1 -> '1 de 1 runtime no informaron'; same export case -> '  trayectorias      — (1 de 1 runtime no informaron)'.
